name: Ananda Sangha Chandigarh
reason: Too thin: the site (robots allows us) has one usable item, the in-person Learn to Meditate class (Rs 700/-); Sunday satsangs are online with no page of their own, the calendar's only event is a 'Health and Healing' fair (health rule), and the home page's dates are stale (31 May / 1 June). Has a real address (2169 Himalaya Marg, Sector 35C) and email chandigarh@anandaindia.org, so worth a recheck later.
